        ### Question
        A 5-day-old male is brought to your office by his mother. The infant is experiencing bilious vomiting, abdominal distension, and overall failure to thrive. A contrast enema shows a transition point at the transverse colon between dilated ascending colon and non-distended distal portion of the colon. Which of the following is the most likely etiology of this patient's disease?

        ### Options
        opa. Muscle hypertrophy
opb. Mechanical bowel obstruction
opc. CFTR gene mutation
opd. Meiotic nondisjunction
ope. Failure of neural crest cell migration

### Reasoning Chains per Option:
CHAIN: "Bilious vomiting" -> "suggests obstruction in the gastrointestinal tract" -> "abdominal distension" -> "indicates accumulation of gas and fluid proximal to obstruction" -> "contrast enema shows transition point at transverse colon" -> "suggests localized point of obstruction" -> "Mechanical bowel obstruction" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Failure of neural crest cell migration" -> "leads to aganglionic segment of the colon" -> "results in Hirschsprung disease" -> "characterized by a transition point in the colon" -> "consistent with findings on contrast enema" -> 90%
CHAIN: "CFTR gene mutation" -> "causes cystic fibrosis" -> "leads to thick, sticky mucus in various organs" -> "possible involvement of gastrointestinal tract" -> "unlikely to cause transition point in colon as primary presentation" -> "unclear direct link to current symptoms" -> 40%
CHAIN: "Muscle hypertrophy" -> "could theoretically cause narrowing of intestinal lumen" -> "unlikely to present with transition point in colon without other structural anomalies" -> "not typically associated with bilious vomiting and failure to thrive in neonates" -> "low probability of being the primary cause" -> 20%
CHAIN: "Meiotic nondisjunction" -> "leads to chromosomal abnormalities" -> "associated with conditions like Down syndrome" -> "these conditions can have gastrointestinal symptoms" -> "no direct causation of transition point in colon" -> "unlikely to explain the specific gastrointestinal findings" -> 30%
